My dear [Mr Graves](../persons.html#577)
I am afraid I must not take Second Fiddles though I am much obliged to you for it.

We are changing our printing house, and I want to have only matters of necessity on my hands just now.[^1]
[Mr Craik](../persons.html#379) is going to send me a photograph of [Bp Patteson](../persons.html#1155)’s sculpture. I hope we shall have it in the next [edition](../books.html#102).

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
